question: Do they release a data set?

evidence: For our experiments, we prepared five sets of documents. Each set has 100 wiki documents (randomly chosen). Each document is restructured randomly (sentences are rearranged randomly). This restructured document is the input to our model and the output document is compared against the original input document.

title: Structuring an unordered text document
answer_rationale: The retrieved documents describe a model for structuring unordered documents using keyword extraction and sentence clustering, but none mention the release of a dataset.
